meta.name: article-magazine
meta.description: Substack / Medium 高级感长文排版, 适合公众号、博客发布

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将文章排版成高级感长文，适合公众号和博客发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将文章排版成Substack或Medium风格的高级感长文
copy.tagline_en: Format articles into premium long-form layouts for WeChat and blogs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to format articles into premium long-form layouts like Substack or Medium

howto.what: 写长文时，Claude 会输出杂志风格的 HTML 排版：顶部大标题、副标题与作者/日期元数据，正文单栏居中约 700px，衬线标题、强调色引用块、深色代码块、居中装饰分隔线，文末附转发卡片。
howto.when: 当你要把一篇长文排版发布到公众号、Substack、博客等平台时，它会接管并生成杂志风格的 HTML 页面。

say.text: 把这篇长文排成杂志风格，标题用衬线字体。
say.note: 生成单栏居中的 HTML 长文页面

say.text: 给文章加上作者、阅读时间和日期元数据。
say.note: 在顶部 hero 区显示这些信息

say.text: 文末加一个转发行动卡片，段落之间用装饰分隔线。
say.note: 输出分隔线与文末卡片

howto.what_en: For long articles, Claude outputs magazine-style HTML: a hero title, subtitle and author/date metadata, a single centered column near 700px, serif headings, accent-bordered quotes, dark code blocks, ornament dividers and a closing share card.
howto.when_en: When you want to lay out a long article for publishing to WeChat, Substack, Medium or similar platforms, it takes over and produces magazine-style HTML.

say_en.text: Lay this long article out as a magazine page with serif headings.
Add author, reading time and date metadata to the top.
say_en.note: Shows them in the hero section

say_en.text: Add a share card at the end and ornament dividers between sections.
say_en.note: Outputs dividers and a share card
